newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Moody's cuts Die Erste financial strength rating.
newsitem.headline: Moody's cuts Die Erste financial strength rating.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Thursday it had cut Die Erste Oesterreichische SparCasse (First Austrian's) financial strength rating to C+ from B following its recent failure to gain a stake in Creditanstalt.
Moody's confirmed First Austrian's long-term deposit rating at A1 and its short-term deposit rating at Prime-1.

"First Austria's failure, as part of the 'Austrian' consortium, to acquire a majority shareholding in Creditanstalt, could add some marginal stress for the bank to preserve and strengthen all the elements of its business franchise," Moody's said.
First Austrian was part of a group bidding for the government's 70 percent of Creditanstalt-Bankverein ordinary voting shares. It lost out in January to market leader Bank Austria.
Moody's said the consolidation of Bank Austria and Creditanstalt would increase pressure for greater rationalisation in the domestic banking sector.
"Nevertheless, First Austrian retains sound fundamentals, which were most recently underpinned by an improved and acceptable financial performance in 1996," Moody's said.
It confirmed First Austrian's long-term subordinated debt at A2. -- Janet McBride, Vienna newsroom, +43-1 531 12 254
